searchLog: Third consecutive day of a total WebFetch outage in this session, now with a more specific diagnosis than the prior two runs: every WebFetch call returns a structured {"error_type":"EGRESS_BLOCKED",...,"message":"Access to <domain> is blocked by the network egress proxy."} error, including job-board JSON (api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/mistral.ai), a Greenhouse posting (job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/...), Anthropic's own careers page (www.anthropic.com/careers/jobs), and a neutral control domain with zero bot-protection (example.com). The only URL that succeeded was raw.githubusercontent.com, which is useless for job postings. This rules out the prior hypothesis (2026-08-05/06 logs) that it was a WebFetch-tool-specific restriction rather than a network-level one: the block is explicit, domain-agnostic, and reported as a network egress policy, not a 403 from the target site. The curl-level $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status diagnostic reports healthy with zero relay failures, so this is specifically the WebFetch tool's own egress allowlist for this cloud environment, not the general HTTP proxy Bash/curl use — meaning it likely traces to the network policy chosen when this environment/routine was created, and is fixable there, not from inside a run. WebSearch worked fine (e.g. surfaced four live Anthropic 'Applied AI Architect' Greenhouse postings by title/URL), but per the honesty rules a search snippet is not sufficient to confirm a posting is open now, eligible, and free of a hidden YOE requirement — that requires loading the real page, which was not possible. Rather than include anything unverified, this run reports zero opportunities, matching 2026-08-05 and 2026-08-06 for the same underlying reason. This is now a 3-day pattern: the network policy for this routine's environment needs to allowlist outbound HTTPS to job-board domains (greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com, lever.co, company career pages) or the hunt cannot verify anything, ever, under the current config.
